hook_text: 1:02 or 0:58: which swimmer won? Hint: it is not the bigger number.
clip_script: Swimming gala in Mossel Bay. Start, stop, reset. Johan: 0:55. Lerato: 0:58. Ayesha: 1:02, that is 62 seconds. Bongani: 1:10, 70 seconds. Smallest time wins, so Johan is first, by 15 seconds over Bongani. Now the calendar. 1 October is a Thursday. Add 7: 8, 15, 22, 29 are Thursdays too. Gala day? Count on from Thursday 15: Friday 16, Saturday 17. Races every 6 minutes from 09:00. Calendar for which day, clock for what time, stopwatch for how long.
visual_style: Stopwatches freezing on each swimmer's time, then a calendar page with Thursdays lighting up in a column.
mood: Splashy and exciting, like a gala with cheering from the stands.
pacing: Race times, the smallest-wins twist, then the calendar jump in sevens.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and time yourself doing 20 star jumps with a stopwatch.
